## Workflow State (WS)

key/label/kind (initial / working / waiting / terminal) + `pausesSlaClock`. Kinds are the enum, states are DATA rows in a Workflow card an ops lead edits. Keys are never renamed once in use. For a FIXED lifecycle use the `statusField` factory from `@cardstack/catalog/fields/status/status` instead — this block is for process-as-data.

### Non-goals

No transition logic here — the Workflow card holds transitions and Run Workflow enforces them.

cardInfo.summary: One state in a data-driven workflow; waiting states pause SLA clocks.
